'''Tomota''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who was a member of the [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. Tomota was the second in command of [[Kai Zykken]], the leader of the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] chapter of the Scoundrels.
